title: The Parts of the Day
label: ch:mr-divasache-bhag
canDo: I can name the parts of the day and say that something happens in one of them.

payoff.summary: From cold: the four parts of the day in the order they happen, the whole day that holds them, and each one turned into an at-that-time word in front of a verb -- including the masculine one that takes -aa where the four feminine ones take -ii.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these atoms and the payoff assesses all of them. No new verb is added: every sentence uses yeto, which the track has had since its first chapter.
